Realistic hourly-marked, no-leverage cash sim: each strategy trades its own $1,000 and the combined is the sum of the 2 base sleeves ($2.0k total) — filter views (e.g. Smart Flow ∩ band) re-slice a ledger already counted and are excluded, so cards don't sum to the total. Positions tie up cash entry→exit (downsized/skipped when committed, never on margin); entries/exits execute on their recorded date, but open positions are marked to their real intraday price between decisions for a smooth curve. Kelly % is walk-forward (out-of-sample) and event-clustered: every trade is staked from the edge known from trades settled before it, averaged one observation per independent settlement day — not per trade, so correlated same-event trades (e.g. several props on one match) can't masquerade as independent evidence. No bet until ≥5 prior independent event-days, no lookahead. The % shown is the rate recommended now; 0 = no proven edge yet → don't bet (capped 50%).
